Account Director, France

Summary

The Account Director is responsible for the sale of OneStream SaaS solutions within a specified territory.
OneStream is looking for an experienced, proactive sales professional to manage and grow existing customer relationships through subscription renewals and expansion, uplifts and cross-selling of additional solutions. The role will be responsible for strategic planning and account management across a designated sales territory and will be expected to take full ownership within this territory. Account Directors are to successfully retain and grow the existing solution footprint and meet and ideally exceed assigned quota. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SaaS sales and a proven track record in sales within an existing account base.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Opportunity Identification: Proactively identify new sales opportunities within the existing customer base by understanding their evolving needs and challenges and OneStream’s value proposition.
  • Upselling and Cross-Selling: Introduce additional products or services that meet the evolving needs of our customers, driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Internal Reporting: CRM knowledge transfer, sales pipeline management, and proposal preparation.
  • Self-Sourced Pipeline: Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Be Business Partner to your Customers: Provide proactive and consultative guidance that will add value to their business objectives, ensuring high retention and net revenue growth for OneStream. This is executed by developing a thorough understanding of your customers' position in the market, their product/service, points of difference and competitive landscape.
  • Position OneStream: Articulately and effectively convey the OneStream value proposition via written, virtual and in-person presentations, by leveraging custom business cases, marketing assets and customer success stories.
  • Enable your Customer Champions: Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation.
  • Achieve sales targets: Develop and execute business plans to achieve sales targets.
  • Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities.
  • Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Ensure timely and accurate knowledge transfer across internal teams, such as Business Development, Pre-Sales, Alliances, and Customer Success, as well as to external collaborators such as Customers, Prospects, and Alliance Partners.
  • Assess prospects and customers’ needs for OneStream offerings via research, discovery sessions and solution demonstrations.
  • Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation.
  • Prepare proposals and SaaS agreements to prospects and customers to drive sales.
  • Identify opportunities for OneStream use case expansion within customer accounts to drive additional revenue.
  • Develop comprehensive proposals in response to client and prospect requests.
  • Actively role model sales professionalism, may engage as a coach and mentor across the Sales teams.

Required Education & Experience

  • Minimum 5-10 years’ experience as a sales manager, sales representative or a related occupation specifically in B2B selling across the Enterprise accounts.
  • Proven track record in hitting quota and retention targets.
  • Organized, detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and respond quickly.
  • Negotiation skills as it relates to renewals, upsell, cross-selling and additional solution add-ons.
  • Highly proficient in MS Office Suite, and CRM systems.
  • Experience working in a consultative capacity with C-level customers on complex SaaS solutions.
  • Extensive customer service experience in assessing and evaluating customer needs and satisfaction and meeting specified standards with respect to products and services.
  • Exceptional oral and written comprehension, communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience demonstrating, promoting, and selling products/services.
  • Knowledge and experience with marketing/sales strategy and tactics.
  • Knowledge of administration, business, and management principles.
  • Experience with MS Office and SFDC, and other analytical or project management tools.
  • Extensive experience working in a team environment.
  • Track record of exceeding revenue goals.
  • Fluent in French and English is a must.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
  • Prior sales experience in the software industry, especially within the CPM/EPM industry.
  • Experience with Salesforce is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Accounting, Finance and Corporate Performance Management.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Professional.

  • Capable of building rapport with C-level executives and customers.
  • Highly organized.

  • Ability to understand and react to customer needs.

3165 - Account Director, Data Operations  - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

 

The Data Delivery & Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end coordination, quality assurance, and governance of media data within the Cockpit programme across multiple markets. Acting as the central point of contact between local market teams, global Nestlé stakeholders, and external data partners, this role ensures the timely delivery of accurate, high-quality data that supports MMM modelling and business decision-making. The successful candidate will drive process consistency, manage complex stakeholder relationships, resolve data-related issues, and oversee programme timelines to ensure smooth and efficient execution across all participating markets.

Data Delivery and Project Management

Own and maintain the Cockpit refresh calendar for all participating markets, ensuring alignment with MMM modelling timelines.

  • Coordinate with local market teams, data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill), and global & z-EUR Nestle to ensure timely submission of accurate data to meet cockpit calendar.
  • Manage ad-hoc refresh requests and assess feasibility against resource and process constraints.

Data Quality Assurance

  • Review and validate incoming media plan data for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to agreed formats (e.g., no channels with impressions but zero spend).
  • Perform central QA checks before data is loaded into Cockpit, or oversee local QA when/if decentralised.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies (e.g., spend, impressions, reach) with local teams.

Process Governance & Standardisation

  • Enforce agreed actualisation processes for Cockpit markets
  • Ensure consistent application of data governance rules, including mandatory metrics, cost allocation, and added value treatment.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the central point of contact for the cockpit program between:

  • Local OpenMind (OM) market teams
  • Global Nestlé stakeholders (e.g., Z-EUR, IT)
  • Data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill)
  • Facilitate alignment calls to resolve blockers and ensure all parties are informed of timelines, dependencies, and changes.
  • Communicate clearly on delays, risks, and mitigation plans.

Primary Skills

  • Strong background in media planning, buying, or media operations with a deep understanding of campaign structures, channels, and metrics.
  • Experience managing multi-market data workflows and working with multiple stakeholders across geographies.
  • Proven ability to interpret and troubleshoot media data (spend, impressions, reach, CPM/CPC calculations).
  • Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical data issues to non-technical stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

3070 - Associate Director, Commerce - UK

Role Summary and Impact 

 As an eCommerce Account Director, you will be responsible for the coordination and delivery of your client accounts across platforms whilst operating as the main campaign activation point of contact for our clients. 

Utilising platform expertise and account management practices, you’ll ensure effective management of projects to brief, schedule and budget. Ultimately, you’ll work to deliver industry-leading eCommerce campaigns which exceed our clients’ expectations.

The role will involve line management of more junior members of the team, overseeing their work and development to successfully deliver to client expectations.

We are looking to continue our exceptional growth, seeking an eCommerce Account Director to come and join the growing community in eCommerce Practice.  

Job Responsibilities: 

Specialist Performance 

  • Responsibility for the output of your team, both client facing and operational, and accountability for adherence to controls and best practices. 
  • Strategic understanding of the clients’ business and KPIs, keeping up to date with latest industry news and proactively spotting trends, product releases, and other opportunities which could enhance our activity. 
  • Maintain a forward thinking and innovative approach in the development of all activity. 

Team Leadership  

  • Develop strong relationships with your client and key suppliers, leading team communications with these stakeholders. Be able to communicate with clients on subject matters (even outside of your remit) and provide them with useful insight. 
  • Take responsibility for your team’s development and career progression within the agency. 
  • Play an active role in recruitment and interviewing processes to build strong teams. 

External and Internal Communication  

  • Communication lead with the client contacts, media partners and internal stakeholders with the support of the Senior Associate Director when required.  
  • Develop strong relationships with your client, and key suppliers. Foster a good working relationship across client team stakeholders to facilitate flawless execution of plans. 

Process and Systems 

  • Helping to drive process automation through adoption of technology and efficient ways of working. 
  • Lead on application and adherence to all areas of activation related finance process. 
  • Contributes to the development of strategic revenue and services opportunities.  

 

Skills and Experience 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

 

About you 

  • In-depth understanding of eCommerce campaign set-up, management, optimisation and reporting across media owner and technology vendor platforms including Amazon, Citrus, Criteo, bid management and Nielsen IQ or similar
  • Amazon DSP and AMC capability beneficial
  • Excellent understanding of the strategic and tactical application of eCommerce and digital marketing in general 
  • Proven project management, leadership and people management experience. 
  • Data-literate – aware of the available resources and how to turn data into insights that shape clear strategic opportunities 
  • Keen to drive continued specialism excellence and client account performance 
  • Operationally proficient 
  • Attention to detail 
  • Calm under pressure 

 
Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 
 
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months. A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels. If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow. About the role We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app. No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team.     • Filter & Route Inquiries: Establish clear operational paths for routine data requests, incident reporting, and tactical items below the executive level, freeing leadership bandwidth for major revenue initiatives.

    • Surface Field Signals: Synthesize customer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and field feedback directly from front-line sales teams to keep executive leadership deeply connected to market realities.
    • Pre-Frame Executive Decisions: Ensure material revenue proposals and strategic escalations reaching the EVP are pre-framed with clear context and explicit recommendations, allowing leadership to focus on high-order strategic decisions.
  • Operational Rhythm & Business Cadence
    • Orchestrate Business Cadence: Maintain the global sales operational rhythm, including leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, strategic offsites, and key team communication forums, ensuring priorities are proactively tracked and fire drills are minimized.
    • Cross-Functional Alignment with Sales Strategy & Operations: Partner seamlessly with Sales Strategy & Operations by translating strategic outputs into operational workstreams, leadership narratives, and review frameworks.
    • Executive Communications & Collateral: Drive end-to-end preparation of strategic collateral, executive presentations, board materials, and organizational communications in close coordination with Internal Comms partners.
  • Track Strategic Priorities & Follow-Through
    • Track & Report on Key Commercial Initiatives: Track high-priority commercial initiatives and global sales bets, ensuring every key initiative has a clearly defined owner, success metrics, and milestones.
    • Accountability & Execution: Ensure regional and functional leaders leave executive reviews with clear action items and deadlines; track ongoing performance against overarching organization priorities.

If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. About you

What we offer

Summary 

 

At OneStream, we're building the AI Operating System for Modern Finance. As the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI, and extends to meet changing business needs, we're empowering some of the world's leading organisations to Take Finance Further. We believe finance leaders need more than traditional Corporate Performance Management (CPM) tools. They need a single, intelligent platform that drives productivity, enables better decisions, and delivers measurable business value.

 

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will play a critical role in helping customers achieve their business goals and maximise the value of their OneStream investment. Acting as a strategic advisor, trusted partner, and primary customer advocate, you will guide customers throughout their journey and beyond, from onboarding and adoption to value realisation, expansion, renewal, and long-term success. By leveraging data-driven insights, AI-powered capabilities, and a consultative, human-centred approach, you will build strong relationships with key stakeholders, understand their unique objectives, and deliver measurable business outcomes that drive retention, growth, and advocacy. Working cross-functionally to unlock the full value of OneStream's capabilities, you will ensure customers not only realise lasting value from their investment but become enthusiastic champions, advocates, and references for our platform.

This position will manage approximately 60 Tier 3 Accounts across EMEA, with the majority of accounts based in France. Fluent English and French are required.

This position is posted as Remote (home-based) in France; however, the successful candidate is expected to prefer a Hybrid working arrangement, splitting time between home office work and 1–2 days per week in the Paris office (located in the Levallois-Perret district) to build stronger in-person collaboration with colleagues, with the opportunity for occasional customer visits as they arise.

 

 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Managing your portfolio of customers
• Partner with sales to complete a comprehensive sales transition process.
• Operate as a business partner to your customer and their delivery team by knowing their strategy and plan.
• Primary ownership and accountability for driving your customer’s adoption, expansion, satisfaction, and renewal.
• Understand customer’s OneStream contractual agreements (Cloud/SaaS, Term, etc.)
• Understand customer’s contractual agreements with their delivery team whether it is with a Partner or with OneStream Services (Scope, Timeline, staffing).
• Manage and execute the customer’s onboarding process.
• Develop strong working relationships with your customers and their delivery team.

Overview

Alnylam is seeking an experienced privacy and data protection leader to serve as Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Privacy, AI Governance, Training & Communications within Ethics & Compliance, this role will lead Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary responsibility for Europe (EU/EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland) and support for broader international markets.

As Alnylam’s formally appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) under applicable European and Swiss privacy laws, the Director will provide independent privacy oversight, advise the business on data protection obligations, and maintain direct access and escalation channels to senior leadership for material privacy risks.

This individual contributor will be expected to serve as a proactive partner to the our international business, anticipating privacy and data protection obligations driven by regulatory change and business growth, and translating those requirements into actionable guidance for policies, operations and ways of working.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement, Ethics & Compliance, and other business stakeholders to enable responsible use of personal data while strengthening privacy governance, risk management, and business adoption across international markets.

Hybrid role preferably based in Zug, Switzerland. Also open to candidates based in Madrid, Spain or Maidenhead, UK.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mature Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary focus on Europe and support for broader international markets, by setting program priorities, strengthening governance frameworks, and ensuring privacy requirements are embedded into business planning, policies, controls, and day-to-day operations.
  • Serve as Alnylam’s appointed DPO under EU GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable Swiss data protection requirements, providing independent advice, monitoring compliance, maintaining required independence, and acting as the primary point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.
  • Oversee privacy risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and escalation processes, including privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, DPIAs, TIAs, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), cross-border transfer assessments, and related governance documentation.
  • Advise business and functional leaders on privacy requirements related to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, commercial operations, medical affairs, human resources, patient support programs, real-world evidence, AI, and other data-driven initiatives.
  • Partner with Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders on privacy incident response, breach assessment, third-party privacy risk management, data protection terms, data sharing arrangements, remediation, and regulatory notification decisions.
  • Proactively monitor the European and international privacy, AI, digital, cyber and data governance legislative landscape, anticipating compliance impacts from business growth and regulatory change, and rapidly translating new or changing requirements into practical updates to policies, controls, business processes, training, and operational guidance.
  • Develop and deliver privacy training, communications, awareness initiatives, metrics, monitoring activities, and continuous improvement plans that promote a culture of privacy and accountability across international markets.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLM, or other advanced legal degree required.
  • 12+ years of privacy legal or compliance experience at a law firm and/or in-house.
  • Significant experience advising on privacy risk in regulated life sciences settings, including clinical research, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, commercial, HR, patient-facing, and digital activities.
  • Experience serving as a DPO or advising in an equivalent independent oversight capacity for GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, or comparable privacy regimes.
  • Deep understanding of GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, international data transfer requirements, and global privacy regulations.
  • Experience advising on AI, data-driven innovation, real-world evidence, cross-border data use, and other strategic privacy initiatives.
  • Strong privacy governance and risk management experience, including the ability to set priorities, mature program controls, and translate complex requirements into practical guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the credibility and judgment to engage senior leaders, regulators, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to lead complex privacy initiatives across matrixed, international organizations, applying practical and proportionate judgment to ambiguous issues.
  • Executive presence, regulatory credibility, and strategic judgment to anticipate legal, business, and technology shifts and translate them into clear priorities for the international privacy program.

Preferred

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or similar credentials preferred.

You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.

 

This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.

 

What you'll do

Advise on AI trust and governance.

Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.

Scope and shape AI build projects.

Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.

Build and deliver.

Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.

Own the relationship through delivery.

Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).

  • Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.
  • Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.

Strong pluses

  • Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.
  • Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).
  • Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.
  • Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.
  • Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.
  • Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.

 

Why this role, why now

AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.

description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solvingLarge organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on. APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now. AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work. Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems. Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen. Our stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, Playwright Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Jest Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Sentry Increasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflows You don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack. Requirements Substantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js Comfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORM Can independently take a feature from unclear starting point to production Can read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewrite Nice to have: Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scale Exposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector search Experience owning systems, not just features Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point. How we hire How we workWe're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process. Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early. How we hireNo seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work. Intro. You, us, and whether this is the environment you're actually looking for. Technical conversation. We go deep on something difficult you've built: the decisions, the alternatives, what you'd do differently now. Technical assessment. Usually live coding on a realistic problem, sometimes a small proof of concept instead. We care how you think, not whether your solution matches ours. Offer. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move. One last thingJob descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. If you're reading this thinking "I can do most of this, but I haven't worked with MCP", apply. Strong fundamentals, meaningful software shipped, and a bias toward ownership are what we're looking for. The rest is learnable. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign. Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Benefits Wir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 28 Tage Urlaub Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt Deine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln. description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Global Programme Director

Location:  London, United Kingdom (1-3 days a week from our London HQ)

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

OLIVER is growing — and we're building our pipeline of senior programme talent ahead of new account wins across our global network.

We're looking to connect with experienced Global Programme Directors who are open to an early conversation about upcoming opportunities. As we pitch for and win major international accounts, we want to hear from programme leaders who thrive in complex, multi-region environments and have a consistent track record of delivering at scale.

This isn't a specific vacancy. It's an invitation to start a conversation.

Based in London, with a hybrid working pattern (1–3 days in our London offices), these roles sit at the intersection of strategic direction, commercial leadership, and operational excellence. We support flexible working and are open to discussing different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout our process.

THE ROLE

Global Programme Directors at OLIVER are the most senior programme voice on their accounts — trusted by clients at executive level and accountable for delivery health, financial performance, and team capability across everything they touch.

You'll lead medium-to-complex, multi-region programmes, bringing together creative, production, technology, and commercial disciplines to deliver transformational outcomes for some of the world's most ambitious brands. You'll drive measurable change within one of the most innovative in-house agency models in the industry — and help shape what programme excellence looks like across OLIVER's global network.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Programme Delivery and Governance

  • Lead medium-to-complex global programmes, maintaining alignment to strategic goals, financial targets, and client expectations throughout
  • Develop and drive programme vision — managing organisational change and delivering integrated outcomes across studios, functions, and geographies
  • Hold full accountability for delivery health: governance, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination across concurrent workstreams
  • Establish and track KPIs; produce regular programme status reports covering risks, issues, and performance metrics; implement corrective actions as needed
  • Lead enterprise-scale transformation programmes centred on technology, people, and process — mapping dependencies, managing timelines, and ensuring nothing falls between workstreams

Commercial Leadership

  • Hold full accountability for account gross profit, including all approvals that affect GP: resourcing decisions, freelancers, expenses, and ad hoc cost requirements
  • Build complex scenario plans across multiple brands and regions, modelling the impact of tools, technology, and commercial decisions on programme performance
  • Create and manage Corrective Action Plans to protect GP targets; make strategic adjustments to people and cost base as required
  • Present revenue forecasting and financial performance to COO, SVP, and executive stakeholders; secure business approvals on decisions with financial implications
  • Drive cost efficiency across tightly resourced teams — identifying and implementing appropriate levers without compromising output quality

Technical and Solution Design

  • Develop deep fluency across OLIVER and BTG technology and services, including delivery platforms, automation tools, and AI
  • Lead senior-level client conversations on technical solutions — knowing when to resolve directly and when to bring in specialist expertise
  • Design solutions that integrate commercial thinking, people resources, and technology to meet client needs at scale
  • Partner with the Senior Leadership Team on solution packaging and client proposals

Resource and Team Leadership

  • Oversee resource scheduling and utilisation across account portfolios, ensuring people are deployed efficiently and workloads are balanced across the wider OLIVER network
  • Work with Client Services and Resource Management on pipeline planning to ensure team structure is correctly sized and skilled at each stage of delivery
  • Ensure clear RACI frameworks are in place across all disciplines; confirm reporting lines and accountabilities are understood across the programme
  • Build and develop programme teams — providing leadership, mentoring, and structured feedback that raises capability and performance at every level

WHAT YOU BRING

  • A strong track record of leading global programme delivery across large-scale, multi-studio account portfolios in complex organisational environments.
  • Ideally Advertising/ Marketing industry experience 
  • Deep expertise in programme and project management — including governance, risk management, delivery health, and stakeholder coordination across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Advanced commercial acumen — experience managing large-scale budgets with direct accountability for gross profit, revenue forecasting, and financial performance reporting to executive stakeholders.
  • Executive-level client partnership experience — building and sustaining trusted relationships with senior clients, managing escalations, and leading strategic conversations with confidence.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop large, geographically distributed teams — creating accountability, clarity, and high performance across diverse disciplines.
  • Experience leading enterprise-scale transformation programmes centred on technology, people, and process change.
  • Fluency with delivery management platforms and operational tools, including Agile and scrum methodologies. Familiarity with automation and AI platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Ability to design commercially viable solutions that integrate people, technology, and process — and to partner with senior leadership on how those solutions are packaged and communicated to clients.
  • A clear track record of meeting and protecting GP targets across complex, multi-region accounts, including experience presenting financial performance and forecasting to COO and SVP-level stakeholders.

Gen AI and Agentic Thinking

  • Strategic integration of AI and automation across programme delivery and studio operations — identifying where these tools create measurable efficiency and quality gains
  • Experience setting AI governance and quality standards at programme or studio level, ensuring responsible and effective adoption across teams
  • Track record of developing AI capability across multiple teams and disciplines, embedding new ways of working into programme operations and client delivery
  • Agentic leadership for complex, multi-stakeholder business challenges — systematic and goal-oriented in approach to problem-solving at scale
  • Thought leadership on AI's evolving role in agency operations, contributing to best practice internally and with clients

Commercial and Budget Skills

  • Experience managing programme-level budgets at significant scale, with accountability for gross profit, scenario planning, corrective action planning, and strategic cost management
  • Confidence presenting budget performance and financial forecasting to senior and executive stakeholders

Qualifications: Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts — gained through work, study, or professional development.

If you're excited about where OLIVER is heading and don't meet every point above, we still encourage you to get in touch.

Our values shape everything we do: 

Be Ambitious to succeed   

Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what’s possible   

Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work   

Be always learning and listening to understand   

Be Results-focused to exceed expectations   

Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations  

Our recruitment process does not employ artificial intelligence for selection. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

OLIVER, a part of the Brandtech Group, is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All applicants shall be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodivergence, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling. Collaboration & feedback: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support. description: LogaRec begleiten dich auf dem Weg zu deiner nächsten Führungsrolle. Seit unserer Gründung verbinden wir IT-Fach- und Führungskräfte mit Arbeitgebern, bei denen Technik, Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum zusammenpassen. Aktuell suchen wir für mehrere Unternehmen parallel: mittelständische und international tätige Organisationen, die ihre IT, Cloud und Plattform professionalisieren, modernisieren oder neu aufstellen wollen. Deshalb ist diese Ausschreibung bewusst breit gehalten. Ob dein Schwerpunkt eher Cloud-Plattform, interne IT, Softwarebetrieb oder die Verbindung aus Entwicklung und Administration ist: Wenn du führen kannst und Technik verstehst, lohnt sich ein Gespräch. Wir begleiten dich vom ersten Austausch über die Vorbereitung auf Gespräche bei den jeweiligen Arbeitgebern bis zur Entscheidung. Welche Umgebung am besten zu dir passt, klären wir gemeinsam; Branche, Größe, Standortmodell und Aufgabenschwerpunkt sind verhandelbar. Aufgaben Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines IT-, IIoT, Cloud- oder Plattform-Teams und entwickelst Menschen, Arbeitsweise und Lieferfähigkeit weiter. Du gestaltest die technische Richtung mit: von interner IT und Betrieb über Cloud- und Plattform-Services bis zur Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklung. Du verbindest Entwicklung und Administration. Architektur, Betrieb, Automatisierung, Sicherheit und Kosten sind für dich keine getrennten Welten. Du modernisierst Infrastruktur und Plattformen mit Blick auf Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security und Wirtschaftlichkeit – on-prem, hybrid oder cloud-native, je nach Umfeld. Du etablierst oder stärkst Standards wie Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Monitoring, Incident- und Change-Prozesse sowie eine klare Zusammenarbeit zwischen Entwicklung, Betrieb und Fachbereichen. Du bist Sparringspartner für Geschäftsführung, Fachbereiche und Entwicklungsteams und übersetzt technische Optionen in nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen. Du baust Strukturen auf oder ordnest Bestehendes: Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Liefermodelle und eine Kultur, in der Wissen geteilt wird. Qualifikation Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und in Administration, Betrieb oder Plattform-Engineering. Beides muss in deinem Werdegang erkennbar sein, die Gewichtung darf unterschiedlich sein. Mindestens 2 bis 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung, fachlich oder disziplinarisch, zum Beispiel als Teamlead, Chapter Lead, IT-Leiter, Head of, Engineering Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Auch wenn du erste Führungsverantwortung mit klarem Wirkungsnachweis hast ist es gut; eine große Linienorganisation ist keine Voraussetzung. Sicherer Umgang mit mindestens einem relevanten Stack aus Cloud (z. B. AWS, Azure, GCP), Container- und Plattform-Technologien (z. B. Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und klassischer System- oder Netzwerkadministration. Erfahrung darin, Betrieb zu stabilisieren und gleichzeitig Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen: Monitoring, Automatisierung, Security-Basics, Release- und Incident-Prozesse. Die Fähigkeit, mit Administration, Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen und gleichzeitig Management und Fachbereiche verständlich abzuholen. Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch; Englisch ist in vielen Umfeldern von Vorteil, aber nicht überall zwingend. Von Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich: Erfahrung mit Muliti-Cloud- oder Hybrid-Setups, Microsoft-365-/Workplace-Umfeldern, ERP- oder fachbereichsnahen Systemen. Berührung mit DevOps-, Plattform-, SRE-, MLOps- oder AI/ LLM-Infrastructure Themen. Budget-, Vendor- oder Dienstleistersteuerung. Aufbau, Merger oder Neuausrichtung einer IT- oder Plattform-Organisation, nicht nur die Führung eines bereits laufenden Teams. Benefits Mehrere Arbeitgeberoptionen aus einem Prozess, statt einer starren Einzelstelle. Hybride oder remote-orientierte Modelle, je nach Unternehmen und deiner Präferenz. Gestaltungsspielraum in Rollen, die IT und Plattform wirklich verantworten, nicht nur Tickets priorisieren. description:
Présentation du poste :

Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.

Ce qu’on attend de vous :

En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.

Vos missions :

  • Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).
  • Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.
  • Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.
  • Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.
  • Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.
  • Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.
  • Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Leadership : Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.
  • Résolution de problèmes : Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.
  • Management & Transmission : Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.
  • Spécialisations (au moins 1) : Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.
  • Stack technique : Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Technical Deep Dive (60 min) : Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

Vous participerez à la modernisation des architectures de données, à la fiabilisation des traitements métiers et à l’amélioration de la gouvernance data, tout en collaborant avec des équipes métiers et techniques internationales.

 

Vous piloterez des équipes pluridisciplinaires tout en contribuant activement à la définition des stratégies data et IA de nos clients.

 

Vos Missions

  • Piloter des projets Data Science et IA de bout en bout, de la définition des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions

  • Accompagner les équipes et assurer le support fonctionnel et technique durant les phases post-migration
  • Contribuer au développement commercial et au rayonnement de la practice Data & Analytics

 

Votre Profil

  • Solide parcours en Data Science, analytics avancée ou intelligence artificielle acquise en cabinet de conseil ou dans un environnement complexe des services financiers

Qui sommes-nous ?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 34 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

People Management

Operational Excellence
